# Model seats

Tiering follows the user's standing rule: fable for hard judgment, opus for medium work, sonnet for evidence and mechanical checks. Never default every seat to fable.

| Role | Agent call | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Worker | `subagent_type: "pave-init:orchestrate-worker", model: "opus"` | Implementation is medium work; opus is fast enough and cheaper than fable per round. |
| DA | `subagent_type: "pave-init:adversarial-investigator", model: "fable"` | Reviewing is the hard-judgment seat; a weak reviewer passes bad work. |
| Evidence | DAs spawn `pave-init:research-delegate` on `sonnet` themselves; workers may spawn `Explore` on `sonnet` | Read-only lookups do not need judgment. |
| Step 1 helper | `subagent_type: "Explore", model: "sonnet"`, no `name`, one per stream | Read-only and short-lived; the worker designs. |

## Always pass `model:` explicitly

Teammate spawns **ignore the `model:` field in the agent's frontmatter** and use the Agent call's `model` parameter, inheriting the parent's model when it is omitted. If you forget `model: "opus"` on a worker, the whole team silently runs on the orchestrator's model and the tiering rule is broken.

## Seats name a tier, not a model id

The Agent tool's `model` parameter accepts only `sonnet`, `opus`, `haiku`, and `fable`, and teammates ignore agent-file frontmatter, so a seat cannot pin a full model id from here. Only the teammate launch command (`CLAUDE_CODE_TEAMMATE_COMMAND`) can set the id per teammate.
